name: live-folder
decision: D68 (shared test 2): the coordinator owns these constants and bands; apps never loosen them in their own PRs, and bands only tighten from at least 10 measured runs.

slots.sends: from record; replaceTrack(null) for the mute

driver.note: Upper bounds of the E1 waits, failing with their step name; revisit at 2-4x the measured p95 (D66). restore is RESUME_BOUND_MS.

evidence.file: evidence.json, written by the driver after Stop and before check.py runs
evidence.times: Session-timeline milliseconds: Date.now() - timelineOriginMs, the origin read from the extension's service worker. May be negative before the folder exists (record).

required.app: lowercase name of the writer under test: gnome, macos (synthetic for make.py)
required.protocolCommit: 40 lowercase hex: the protocol commit the app vendors
required.newFolders: names of the Recording-* folders that appeared in the Library during the run
required.actions: {name: {requestedAtMs, observedAtMs}} for every name in actions below; requestedAtMs <= observedAtMs
required.slotC: {connectionState, packetsReceived}: slot C's peer state and inbound-rtp packetsReceived sampled just before Stop
required.nativeTones: {microphone: Hz}: the tone the app's test microphone plays

optional.captureId: the capture's id, for the log
optional.timelineOriginMs: the origin used for every time above

actions.record: requested: record(); observed: status with path and captureId, and A's track holds 1000 ms of frames
actions.meOff: requested: selectMe(false); observed: the last selection event shows me:false
actions.mute: requested: muteSlot(remote, 0) once F(A) >= MUTE_START_MS; observed: replaceTrack(null) resolved
actions.unmute: requested: switchReceiveSlot(remote, 0, [A]) once F(A) >= mute + MUTE_MS; observed: F(A) advanced by PROOF_MS
actions.lateRemote: requested: switchReceiveSlot(remote, 1, [B]) after unmute, at or after LATE_REMOTE_MS; observed: a new sourceTrackId with PROOF_MS of frames
actions.meOn: requested: selectMe(true) once S >= MIC_ON_MS; observed: selection me:true and a microphone span with PROOF_MS of frames
actions.kill: requested: SIGKILL of the one live audio-host pid once S >= KILL_AT_MS; observed: othersSource system/lost
actions.restore: requested: the kill's observation; observed: othersSource browser/restored and new span ids under A's and B's keys, each with PROOF_MS of frames
actions.stop: requested: stop() once S >= restore + STOP_AFTER_RESTORE_MS; observed: state is not recording and the end event is written
